t=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$t/dest"
cd "$t/dest"
for s in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000 20260104-000000; do
  printf 'x\n' > "demo-$s.tar.gz"
  shasum -a 256 "demo-$s.tar.gz" > "demo-$s.tar.gz.sha256"
done
R=/Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakfp30-d
echo '--- rotate --keep=2 (long form, = syntax): expect 2 oldest deleted, sidecars gone'
bash "$R/rotate.sh" --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep=2
ls "$t/dest"
echo '--- rotate --dry-run --keep 1: would delete remaining oldest, delete nothing'
bash "$R/rotate.sh" --quiet -n --dest "$t/dest" --name=demo --keep 1
echo '--- unknown option must exit 1'
bash "$R/rotate.sh" --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --bogus; echo "rc=$?"
echo '--- keep 0 must be rejected'
bash "$R/rotate.sh" --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep 0; echo "rc=$?"
echo '--- -h exits 0 with usage'
bash "$R/rotate.sh" -h | head -n 1; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo '--- verify --name filter + missing archive BAD'
rm "$t/dest/demo-20260104-000000.tar.gz"
bash "$R/verify.sh" --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo; echo "rc=$?"
echo '--- malformed sidecar still BAD'
printf 'not-a-sidecar\n' > "$t/dest/broken.tar.gz.sha256"
bash "$R/verify.sh" --quiet --dest "$t/dest"; echo "rc=$?"
rm -rf "$t"
tool_input.description: Manual checks of rotate and verify option handling
Remove scratch script and show changed files

result:
All done and verified. Summary of the changes:

**Bug fixes**
- `rotate.sh` — the surplus set was `list_archives | tail -n +"$keep"`, i.e. "from line KEEP to the end" of the oldest-first list, which *included the newest* archive and fired even when `total == keep` (the `-lt` guard). Fixed to `head -n $((total - keep))` (everything *before* the KEEP newest) with the guard changed to `-le`, so exactly N archives now triggers "nothing to rotate".
- `verify.sh` — the sidecar name was extracted with `awk '{print $2}'`, which stops at the first space, so `my backup-…tar.gz` became `my`, was reported "archive missing" → BAD, exit 2. Now the line is parsed with `^([0-9a-fA-F]+)[[:space:]]+(.+)$` (digest = first hex word, name = the whole remainder), the redundant empty-field check (subsumed by the regex) was dropped, and the digest comparison is quoted.

**Refactor**
- New `lib/common.sh` (with a double-source guard like `lib/log.sh`) holding the identical option-parsing block as `parse_common_options`, plus `is_uint`, `need_value`, and `resolve_dir`. `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` source it and call `parse_common_options "$@"` — same flags, same `parse_local_option` contract. `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh` untouched.

**Tests** (`tests/run_tests.sh`): one test per bug — `rotate --keep 3` with exactly 3 archives deletes nothing and keeps all files; `verify` reports `ok … / rc=0` for an intact archive named `my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz`. `bash tests/run_tests.sh` → all 8 tests pass. (One leftover sanity script remains at `/tmp/rotate_verify_checks_soakfp30d.sh`; deleting it in `/tmp` needed an approval this session didn't grant.)

Changed files: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`, plus new `lib/common.sh`.
